# occt-import-js 0.0.24

STEP, IGES and BREP reader: OpenCascade compiled to WebAssembly, from
https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js (dist folder, unmodified).

Used by the Big Ben CAD page (`aft-turbine-v3-cad.html`) through `aft-turbine-v3-cad-worker.js`.
It is only downloaded when a file is opened. Both libraries are LGPL-2.1; the licence texts are in
`license.occt-import-js.txt` and `license.occt.txt`.
